The workbook generation failed due to Excel #NAME? errors in the statistics section, indicating invalid formula syntax or missing named ranges.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' worksheet returned #NAME? instead of the expected floating-point values (e.g., H46 expected -1.7216, got #NAME?). This error typically occurs when openpyxl writes a formula containing a function or range name that Excel does not recognize.
